Assessment
PATIENT: Tamatha Huel (MRN SYN-0735320, DOB 1996-03-29)
PRENATAL SUMMARY: 28-year-old primigravida (G1P0) at 34+5 weeks gestation (LMP 2023-10-04, EDD 2024-07-10). Current weight 80 kg (pre-pregnancy weight 66 kg). Current medications: prenatal multivitamin with 0.8 mg folic acid daily, diphenhydramine 25 mg PO at bedtime PRN itching. No known allergies. Family history notable for mother with severe third-trimester itching in both pregnancies.

CLINICAL PRESENTATION & URGENT CARE EXAM: Presents with worsening pruritic rash over ~2 weeks and severe sleep disruption (3-4 hours/night), plus nocturnal itching of palms and soles. Urgent care physical exam (2024-05-29) showed BP 116/72, HR 84, weight 80 kg, anicteric sclerae, soft non-tender gravid abdomen without RUQ tenderness, and erythematous urticarial papules and small plaques within the abdominal striae sparing the periumbilical skin and spreading to the upper thighs with scattered excoriations. No primary lesions on palms or soles, no vesicles or bullae, no burrows, finger webs and wrists clear. No household contacts itching.

LABORATORY REVIEW & VALIDITY:
- Retracted/Invalid Results (2024-05-29 specimen): Total bile a
